fragments.contract: Create cattle Debian cloud VMs with BKC SSH key, admin-deploy/changeme123 console access, qemu guest agent, and cloud-init completion before post-boot automation.
do_not_regress: Create OpenStack cloud-init guests with --config-drive true in this lab; metadata service fallback produced DataSourceNone and no authorized keys.
Do not replace VMs unless enable_replace_swarm_vms is true.
Do not make Fedora the default until its official image URL is verified and cached.
Do not claim success before SSH and Docker swarm membership are validated.

fragments.contract: Download the official Docker static archive on Server1, copy it through the tenant namespace, install dockerd as a systemd service, run swarm init on bkc-swarm-01, join bkc-swarm-02 and bkc-swarm-03, then validate with docker node ls.
